# Enovitae.com

> Enovitae is a wine-focused digital publication offering curated content on Italian and French wine guides, wine industry trends and data, sustainability, technology, and AI in winemaking.

- Source: https://enovitae.com
- Contact: info@enovitae.com
- License: All rights reserved unless otherwise stated. Educational and citation use allowed with attribution.
- Commercial-use: disallowed

## Academy

- [You won’t be able to afford your favorite wine anymore — Here’s why"](https://enovitae.com/en/academy/you-wont-be-able-to-afford-wine-anymore-heres-why.txt): Explore how rising wine prices and tariffs disrupt the wine industry and alter consumer behavior, with insights from Jessica Dupuy's article on Forbes.
- [Non potrai più permetterti il tuo vino preferito: ecco perché](https://enovitae.com/it/accademia/non-potrai-piu-permetterti-vino-preferito-ecco-perche.txt): Prezzi in aumento e tariffe sconvolgono l'industria del vino, limitando le scelte per i consumatori e danneggiando il mercato globale. Cosa succederà nel 2025.
- [Challenging year for Champagne in 2024: sales decline and price impact](https://enovitae.com/en/academy/challenging-year-champagne-2024.txt): Explore the challenges of the 2024 Champagne vintage, including sales declines, reduced yields, and expected price increases.
- [Annata difficile per lo Champagne 2024: calo delle vendite e impatto sui prezzi](https://enovitae.com/it/accademia/annata-difficile-champagne-2024.txt): Scopri le difficoltà dell'annata 2024 per lo Champagne, con calo delle vendite, riduzione delle rese e le previsioni di aumento dei prezzi.
- [The transformation of the organic wine market in Italy: data from 2010 to 2024](https://enovitae.com/en/academy/organic-wine-market-italy-2010-2024.txt): A detailed analysis of the evolution of the organic wine market in Italy from 2010 to 2024, focusing on growth, consumer trends, and future forecasts.
- [La trasformazione del mercato del vino biologico in Italia: dati dal 2010 al 2024](https://enovitae.com/it/accademia/mercato-vino-biologico-italia-2010-2024.txt): Mercato del vino biologico in Italia dal 2010 al 2024: superficie certificata +68%, tendenze di consumo e previsioni per un settore in continua crescita.
- [Wine market 2024: global consumption, consumer trends and Italian data](https://enovitae.com/en/academy/italian-wine-market-2024.txt): Data, trends, and 2024 forecasts for the wine market: global consumption by continent, shifting consumer preferences, and Italian market figures.

- [Esplorando il mondo dello champagne: tipi, bottiglie, dosaggi, temperature e le migliori annate](https://enovitae.com/it/accademia/caratteristiche-champagne.txt): Dalla cuvée de prestige ai dosaggi, scopri i diversi tipi di champagne: bottiglie, temperature di servizio e migliori annate per una degustazione completa.
- [The Chef de Cave: the master behind champagne's finest bubbles](https://enovitae.com/en/academy/chef-de-cave-champagne.txt): The role of the Chef de Cave in champagne: from assembling cuvées to selecting vintages, the craftsperson who gives life to the world's most prized bubbles.

- [Lo Chef de Cave: il maestro dietro le bollicine dello champagne](https://enovitae.com/it/accademia/chef-de-cave-champagne.txt): Il ruolo del Chef de Cave nello champagne: dall'assemblaggio delle cuvées alla selezione delle annate, la figura che dà vita alle bollicine più pregiate.

- [AI and wine: from the vineyard to the sommelier, technology changes everything](https://enovitae.com/en/academy/ai-winemakers-technology-vineyard.txt): How artificial intelligence is transforming winemaking — from vineyard management with drones and sensors to supporting sommeliers with pairings and tastings.
